_comment: Full-day market closures for spot FX / spot metals. Only days when the venue is genuinely CLOSED (not merely thin-liquidity early-close days). Source: CME Group holiday calendar (https://www.cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar.html) and ICE/EBS spot FX conventions, cross-checked 2026-07-26. Dates are the local New-York calendar date of the closure. Markets '*' = all instruments; otherwise the listed symbols. IMPORTANT: beyond 'covered_through_year' the calendar is UNKNOWN — the engine must fall back to last-closed-candle age (state 'data_lagged'), never assume 'open'.
